# PR #549 · Independent final review of issue #364

**CHANGES_REQUIRED. Hold the merge at `580aded6`.** Both defects identified by scan 2 are corrected. One additional introduced defect can leave a run waiting for a Claude process that Windows has already refused to start. This is formal general scan **3 of 3**, conducted in a fresh context configured as GPT-6.2 Astra MAX. [PR #549](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549)

## F3 · P2 · A proved turn start refusal can wait indefinitely for filesystem metadata

The normal turn dispatch passes `timeoutMs: null`. An inference node’s watchdog is optional, and the loop’s default run deadline is null. Under these supported defaults, the runner installs no timer for the turn. When the child emits an error without a PID, the runner records the refusal, starts the filesystem observation and postpones `finish(null)` until the observation resolves. The subsequent child close explicitly returns while a refusal is recorded. If a metadata read remains pending, the caller receives neither the failure nor its definite non-submission status. The run can remain active until the read returns or someone cancels it. On the target branch the error handler completed the failed start immediately. [Turn dispatch](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L509-L525) · [Watchdog default](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/contracts/src/nodes.ts#L401-L409) · [Run deadline default](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/contracts/src/loop.ts#L46-L55) · [Watchdog implementation](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/engine/src/handlers/common.ts#L147-L154) · [Runner timer](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/process.ts#L170-L178) · [Current refusal and close](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/process.ts#L229-L247) · [Target behavior](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/4cec0f9bbe34f2ae13e4e38182c033b799c19f3f/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/process.ts#L161-L169)

A concrete ordering starts with successful version, help and login probes. The turn’s working directory then becomes unusable, the native spawn returns no PID and emits `ENOENT`, and the post-refusal stat on the configured path or working directory stalls. Even a delivered child close cannot complete the result. The saved independent driver already holds a stat unresolved while delivering a refusal and close. Its two variants explicitly cancel or supply a 15 ms deadline. Both correctly settle. The unbounded-default finding follows from the current production branches. A naturally stalled Windows filesystem was not observed in this audit. [Filesystem observations](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/process.ts#L70-L85) · [Archived controlled driver](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-claude-start/independent/controlled-seam-qa.mjs#L22-L29) · [Repository regression cases](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/process-failure.test.ts#L243-L268)

**Required correction · FIX-IN-PR.** Bound the time spent waiting for optional diagnosis after a genuine no-PID refusal. On expiry, return the established spawn code with unknown cause and definite non-submission, using the existing public failure contract. Preserve timely factual diagnoses, earlier cancellation or deadlines, and ordinary started-turn behavior. Cover a public turn with successful prerequisites, no configured watchdog, no external abort, and a required metadata read held pending past the diagnostic bound. Verify the fixed failure, one attempted turn, no kill or retry, released timer/listener, and an immutable result after late metadata arrives. This is a liveness defect introduced by the original #364 runner change. D176 requires the known process failure and submission semantics to remain authoritative. [D176](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/364#issuecomment-7060507495)

## Disposition of scan 2

- **F1, false authentication from partial output, is corrected.** The harness checks established output loss before readiness inference and before either auth branch can set the signed-out fact. With auth-like stdout or classified stderr, a failed pipe and close code 1 or null, the independent public observations returned `unknown`, omitted `authenticated` and retained the fixed unreadable-output message. Completed sign-out still produced `auth` and `authenticated: false`. Unconfirmed termination, abort, start refusal, timeout, overflow and typed callback failure retain priority. [Outcome order](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L171-L210) · [Authentication handling](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L306-L331) · [Independent observations](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-probe-correction/independent-qa/observations-01.json)
- **F2, loss of the help-only cause, is corrected.** The private `CheckProcessFailure` carries the existing nonretryable `HARNESS_TURN_FAILED` code. The help wrapper preserves it, including fixed missing/file check-folder details, unexplained ENOENT/EACCES/UNKNOWN and output loss. Version and auth succeeded independently in the mixed cases. Genuine completed option failures retained versioned guidance. The original-source counterfactual reproduced both old defects. The historical scan 2 report remains **CHANGES_REQUIRED** at its own head, SHA-256 `4948e0b8d2c46044fa16da1fc04e77547c87ac2c40e31c75b2b34e386a95c637`. [Private cause](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L103-L113) · [Help wrapper](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L335-L358) · [Scan 2](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7062502810) · [D193](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7062503002) · [D198](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7062859601)

The remaining source preserves the issue’s diagnostic and privacy boundaries. Only an error from a child without a PID admits filesystem observations. An established missing absolute executable remains restorable. A missing/file turn directory produces pinned configuration failure. Ambiguous evidence yields a fixed unknown-cause message. The runner handles secondary pipe errors after refusal, requests owned-tree shutdown for a started child’s output loss and preserves uncertain delivery against later rejection text. The changes add no fallback execution, retry, PATH search, provider change or raw path disclosure in these diagnostics. The private cause avoids message matching and leaves the engine contract intact. [Runner](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/process.ts#L216-L251) · [Failure mapping](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L122-L158) · [Turn delivery](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/packages/infrastructure/src/claude/harness.ts#L525-L552)

## Source and evidence

- **Authorship and review.** I checked both actual Claude Opus 5.5 provider streams, xhigh launch configurations, single successful terminal envelopes, zero exits and exact complete final-message bytes. The original final SHA-256 is `404fa3f62ec7c0f1b84e19fd9bdab60dd922552b179a8036429f98f8d890478e`. The correction final SHA-256 is `0ae91c94cb149b3fdc0760910997813c1346d14d9476a70ef4ce1bcdfdd0cad0`. The independent opposite-family first review approved the original source. The correction changed five files. Its author recorded 296 passes and two owner-CLI skips, with scoped coverage of 100% lines and 98.72% branches. Final test bytes failed 19 predicted cases on the original source. Four mutations failed 11, 9, 4 and 4 cases. Initial formatting/lint failures and temporary rollback records remain. The earlier whole Windows infrastructure run recorded 51 failures, 1,153 passes and two skips. Its 259-pass/two-skip focused run remains scoped. [First review](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7060993847) · [Author report](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-probe-correction/correction-author/author/REPORT.md) · [Original author record](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-claude-start/author/REPORT.md)
- **Independent behavior QA.** Original QA recorded 42 native/harness, 55 built REST/engine/SQLite and 23 long-TEMP predicates in overlapping tiers. It preserved the initial HTTP admission fixture error, 19/20 controlled assertions, the corrected cancellation check at 3/3, and the original-source control at 3/3. Corrective QA passed 191 public/control/native/counterfactual predicates and 81 HTTP/auth/SQLite predicates on the successful executions. I inspected the independently specified expected messages, raw observations, source/build hashes, 49-member seal and earlier API failures. The first API driver missed the engine message prefix after 10 passes. The second omitted `observedSeq` after 12 passes and received HTTP 400. Their successes are excluded from the final 272. [Original QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7060996178) · [Corrective QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7063079147) · [Issue readback](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/364#issuecomment-7063274103)
- **Public boundaries.** The saved built-stack evidence includes unauthenticated HTTP 401, four HTTP 422 refusals with no new execution rows, four admitted runs whose start prerequisite then failed, and eight HTTP 409 responses across four store reopenings. Two matching submission observations refer to one intent in each failed run. The successful control recorded one harmless native turn. Started-process output loss used controlled streams with the real built classifier. The missing/file help-only cases used intentionally altered and restored native check directories. At release all 83 recorded PIDs were absent and seven listeners refused connections. These observations establish behavior on the measured Windows host and controlled boundaries. Live provider behavior and naturally occurring pipe loss remain unverified. [HTTP matrix](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-probe-correction/independent-qa/api-observations-03.json) · [Release receipt](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-probe-correction/independent-qa/release-receipt.json)
- **Integration and publication.** The effective target-to-head diff covers 380 paths, including 368 evidence files. All seven #364 source/test/fixture blobs match corrected `b90ffd2d` and prior integration `4b822d67`. I reconstructed the two guides from disjoint parent edits, checked the three additive conflict resolutions, and compared all 35,791 other path entries against the applicable parent blobs and modes. The six newly inherited #442 product/test paths match main. Its shared readiness classifier body is byte-identical across the integration. Direct reads of 1,392 distinct Git blobs matched all **1,929** archived file paths and original hashes across the six packets (158, 210, 243, 339, 272, 707). I verified 795 integration receipt members and 111 correction-publication receipt members. The original packet retained 24 excluded store/key/binary members locally with hashes. The correction packet contains 202 exact originals plus eight archive documents/metadata files. Its recorded six-pattern credential check found zero candidates. The integration helper’s naming collision occurred after the successful commit and was repaired for receipt collection. The independent QA checkout and index remained at the sealed correction. [Original packet](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-claude-start/README.md) · [Correction packet](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-probe-correction/README.md)
- **Current hosted gates.** I independently downloaded the six current job logs and both artifact ZIPs and compared them byte-for-byte to the saved copies. Run **44913144773**, attempt 1, passed all six jobs with 10,149 unit passes, 62 unit skips, 488 browser passes with zero configured retries and 27 Windows launcher passes. All 13 package summaries clear the unchanged 90% line/branch thresholds. The minima are 95% lines and 90.97% branches. The ordinary dependency audit reports seven low and 13 moderate findings, zero high/critical. Native artifact `14709934631` contains 9,194 bytes, SHA-256 `9273927a67c99d3f0575262a39e594bf01377cf83322d4b3ea0bb3feb7c633fc`. Its three files, 338 observation records, manifest revision bindings and saved exact canonical replay matched. The tested synthetic merge has parents target/head and the exact reviewed tree. Runs 44908713842 and 44895005482 bind earlier revisions. The hosted Windows launcher suite covers its own acceptance cases. [CI run](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44913144773) · [Published CI receipt](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/549#issuecomment-7064303478)

The final GitHub readback at 14:58:27 UTC on November 21 showed the open draft, current main at the target above, one closing reference to #364, zero review threads and zero native PR reviews. The formal reports were published as conversation comments. The PR says `Closes #364` and `Part of #279`. Ordinary engineering closure applies to #364. Owner obligations #448, #459, #439 and #452, Mac PR #501 and held PR #460 remain separate. All three general scans are consumed. F3 requires the repository’s capped correction, independent QA, current CI/native and coordinator disposition before merge. This review performed read-only source and evidence inspection. Deployment and whole-intent acceptance remain outstanding. [Issue #364](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/issues/364) · [Issue workflow](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/15-issue-workflow.md) · [Delivery register](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0/docs/delivery/2026-11-17-five-intents-register.md)

# D203 — Bound optional Claude start-refusal diagnosis after final scan 3

Fresh Astra MAX final scan 3 of PR #549 returned CHANGES_REQUIRED at head 580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0 against main 4cec0f9bbe34f2ae13e4e38182c033b799c19f3f. It verified the two previous probe defects corrected and found F3: actual turns pass timeoutMs:null, while the node watchdog and run deadline can be absent. After a genuine no-PID refusal, the new code waits for optional filesystem metadata and ignores child close. A stalled metadata read can therefore prevent the already established launch failure from reaching the run. The finding is source-established and supported by saved controlled stalled-read fixtures; a naturally stalled Windows filesystem was not observed. Original final report SHA-256: b7d9f7428fbc3bae56e554355e97e0054e1429929107ac9514478f60e3f0ac56.

Select FIX-IN-PR under the owner's delegated blocker decisions. Give optional post-refusal diagnosis one absolute monotonic 1,000 ms budget starting when the no-PID refusal is observed, independent of the turn's configured timeout. Fast observations keep the existing factual cause. If the budget expires, return the original fixed spawn code with no cause: the existing unknown start-failure contract, still definitely not submitted. Expiry must not invent a process timeout, cancellation, missing executable or invalid directory. Earlier aborts and request deadlines retain priority and prompt settlement; normal started processes keep their existing behavior.

Check the monotonic deadline when accepting an observation as well as in the timer callback, so a delayed event-loop callback cannot accept late metadata as timely. Do not start a subsequent metadata lookup after settlement or budget expiry. Clear the diagnostic timer and remove the existing abort listener on every settlement; ignore late observations without changing the returned result. Already issued filesystem operations may complete later: this is a bound on waiting for optional diagnosis, not a claim that Node cancels an underlying stat. No extra launch, kill of a nonexistent child, retry, fallback, PATH resolver or public configuration option is introduced.

One second permits ordinary local metadata to add useful detail while bounding a known failed start even for a default run with no watchdog. Slow or unavailable metadata may therefore produce the conservative generic refusal rather than a more specific cause. Decline relying on caller timeouts, because the supported default has none; decline immediate unconditional unknown, which would discard useful fast diagnoses; decline synchronous filesystem access or a new worker/process subsystem for this small correction; decline new user-facing timeout configuration and any automatic retry. Preserve the earlier output-loss and help-only corrections and all original failed observations.

Use the existing D035/D042 capped completion path. All three general scans are consumed and remain recorded; no fourth general scan or renewed Astra approval is selected. GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh implements the bounded backend/test/documentation correction under GPT architecture. Actual Claude Fable 5.2 xhigh independently reviews this delta, and a separate actual Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh context performs criterion-specific behavior QA. Respect the reported Claude reset and capacity limit. Then archive original records, run current-head/current-target ordinary CI and canonical native verification, and record coordinator completion before any ordinary signed merge.

Require a public turn with successful prerequisites, timeoutMs:null, no watchdog or external abort, and a required metadata read pending past the new budget. Observe a terminal fixed failure, definite non-submission, one attempted turn, no kill/retry, timer/listener cleanup and immutable late-result behavior. Also check timely diagnoses, delayed-result/monotonic-bound handling, shorter deadlines/abort, stronger failures and normal started behavior. Use a finite old-source control rather than weakening the oracle or retrying unchanged failures. Independent QA must distinguish controlled metadata delays from genuine native spawn refusal and from a naturally occurring filesystem stall.

Update docs/06 and add ADR-0089 for this new private diagnostic-time decision; ADR-0088 is reserved by the concurrent #486 source. No schema, stored-content, owner environment, dependency, coverage threshold or scope expansion is authorized. New large evidence belongs on G: under D202; existing packets and provider records stay byte-exact. Present this choice, its conservative fallback tradeoff and rejected alternatives in the final owner catalogue before owner QA.

pr.body:
Windows can report spawn ENOENT for an unusable working directory even when Claude's executable exists. This change diagnoses genuine no-PID refusals using bounded filesystem observations: a proved missing absolute executable remains restorable, a missing/file working directory becomes pinned configuration failure, and ambiguous refusals remain unknown. No PATH resolver, retry or fallback launch is added.

Closes #364. Part of #279.

The runner contains pipe errors from never-started children and preserves uncertainty for started children after output loss. Termination and cancellation remain ahead of diagnosis. Public messages use fixed text without raw native paths, arguments or diagnostic bodies. Following final scan 2, the bounded probe correction also refuses to classify partial output as authentication/readiness and preserves the fixed help-only start-refusal cause. D176, D193 and D198 record these choices.

Actual Claude implemented the original change and the correction. Independent GPT review 1 approved the original source; fresh Astra scan 2 found the two probe defects and remains recorded as CHANGES_REQUIRED. Fresh Astra MAX scan 3 also returned CHANGES_REQUIRED: the two previous probe defects are corrected, but default turns can wait indefinitely for optional metadata after a genuine no-PID refusal. Its complete report is preserved below. All three general scans are consumed.

Validation and limits:
- Original independent QA: 42 native/public predicates, 55 built REST/engine/SQLite predicates and 23 long-TEMP predicates. These overlapping tiers have no aggregate total. Initial fixture/admission and classifier-control failures are preserved with their bounded corrections.
- Corrective independent QA: 191 public/control/native/counterfactual predicates and 81 built HTTP/auth/SQLite predicates passed. Two earlier API-driver attempts failed on the expected-message oracle and missing observedSeq; their original scripts, stores and results remain. Controlled output loss exercises the real classifier; owned native directory failures are intentionally induced. This is not a naturally observed pipe failure or live provider request.
- The corrective HTTP matrix checks authentication refusal, preflight rejection without execution records, admitted start failure, nonretry behavior, Resume refusal across store reopen and exactly one harmless successful turn. All 83 recorded PIDs were absent and seven listeners refused connections. Source/build binding remained unchanged.
- Actual Claude corrective author checks: 296 passed / 2 owner-CLI skips, with scoped Claude coverage 100% lines / 98.72% branches; original-source and four mutation controls expose the selected defects. The original whole-infrastructure attempt remains 51 failed / 1,153 passed / 2 skipped. Scoped checks do not claim full-package coverage.

Current head `580aded6d295061897b047ac16811e5da230d9e0` ordinarily integrates main `4cec0f9bbe34f2ae13e4e38182c033b799c19f3f`. All #364 production and test blobs match the corrected source `b90ffd2d`. Seven of its ten changed paths match both `b90ffd2d` and preceding integration `4b822d67`; CHANGELOG and the two operator guides combine the parents' documented additions. All 1,929 archive files remain exact across six own/inherited packets. The [original evidence](docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-claude-start/README.md) and [probe correction](docs/qa/2026-11-21-i4-364-probe-correction/README.md) retain original provider envelopes, reviews, failed attempts, scripts, source bindings and explicit local-only exclusions for the original packet. The new correction archive contains 202 byte-exact originals and no sensitive exclusions or derivatives.

Fresh [CI run 44913144773](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/44913144773) passed all six jobs on this head and target: 10,149 unit tests passed / 62 skipped, 488 browser tests passed without retries, and 27 native Windows tests passed. All 13 package coverage reports clear the existing 90% line and branch thresholds (minimum 95% lines / 90.97% branches). The ordinary unfiltered audit reports 7 low and 13 moderate findings, with no high or critical finding. The tested synthetic merge `bab7d3c2316a57edc09a53effff9c2a6b74a594a` has the exact candidate tree `49f4ae66198c4699867cab6c4f95c9ab4bf863b7`. Downloaded native artifact `14709934631`, SHA-256 `9273927a67c99d3f0575262a39e594bf01377cf83322d4b3ea0bb3feb7c633fc`, passed canonical replay of 338 records with matching head, target, run, merge and source tree.

Prior run 44908713842 passed all six jobs at `4b822d67`/`02a00009`; it remains historical after #552 merged. This draft is held for D203's bounded correction: a private 1,000 ms monotonic diagnosis budget returns the existing unknown start failure on expiry, without changing definite non-submission or inventing a process timeout. Sol implementation, actual Fable corrective review, separate actual Opus QA, a new evidence capsule, current-head/current-target CI/native verification and the existing D035/D042 coordinator completion remain required. No fourth general scan or renewed Astra approval is claimed. No owner deployment, provider acceptance or whole-intent completion is implied.
